evidence.recording:
2 recording notes captured

Composition The track is written by Phil Wilde, Ray Slijngaard, Xavier Clayton and Filip Martens, and was produced by Wilde with Jean-Paul De Coster.

Gail Heritage of Port Lincoln Times described it as "a mix of rhythmic beat, almost changing at every eight bars, centring around the harmonic voice of Anita, before looming into a jungle of rap by Ray." She added, "'Tribal Dance' was one of my favourites on the album — those jungle drums just seem to be calling me to the dance floor." James Hamilton from the Record Mirror Dance Update named it a "jungle drummed simple chanting galloper" in his weekly dance column.
